metadata.description: Claude Code skills for SEO teams and Keyword.com users — rank tracking, keyword research, and reporting workflows built on the Keyword.com MCP.

plugins.name: keyword-com-base
plugins.description: Shared base plugin that registers the Keyword.com MCP server.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Set up a Keyword.com rank-tracking project from a URL: crawl the site's pages and blog, distill product + content topics, expand into real MSV-backed keywords, and create the tagged project.

plugins.name: agency-prospecting
plugins.description: End-to-end SEO prospect outreach: Apollo contact search + enrich → seed keyword from their site → white-labeled Keyword.com ViewKey report → personalized cold-email draft. Pulls in the keyword-com-base dependency for the Keyword.com MCP; Apollo is added via Connectors.
